question: Whenever three or more red buckets are clearly visible at this well, tell me the current count and check whether visitors are allowed to draw water there.

responses.response: Three red buckets are clearly visible at the well; I'll check visitor rules.
responses.trigger_type_reason: The trigger is established by visible red buckets and the well signage; speech and music are not needed.

evidence.fact: A grey brick archway shows gold characters 大板井, identifying the well site.
The camera reaches a large circular stone-lined well where people are gathered with containers.
Three red buckets are clearly and simultaneously visible at the well: one on a rope over the opening, one on the left rim, and one on the right side.

details.counting_basis: Only red plastic water buckets that are sufficiently unoccluded in the well area at 01:57 are counted; white jugs, red lanterns, stools, and partially occluded red buckets are excluded.
details.deduplication_rule: Buckets are identified by position and rope/handle within the continuous well shot; a bucket leaving and re-entering frame is the same target, and the count is the current visible set, not cumulative appearances.

trigger.definition: Three or more red buckets are clearly visible at this well.

conditions.condition: The scene is the well identified by the 大板井 archway.
conditions.evidence: Archway sign visible at 01:52-01:53 and the circular well is visible by 01:56.

conditions.condition: At least three red buckets are simultaneously clearly visible in the well area.
conditions.evidence: One bucket hangs on a rope, one rests on the left rim, and one is on the right side.

messages.content: Three red buckets are clearly visible at the well; I'll check visitor rules.
